If Euka is not the right fit, the best alternatives are the other TikTok Shop affiliate platforms (Reacher, Cruva, Colaba, Hubfluence) or a managed agency if you would rather not run software at all. Euka is a capable all-in-one platform at ~$159 to $479/mo, but like every tool in the category, it needs an operator, so pick your alternative based on whether you want different software or a different model entirely.

Whichever platform you pick, the tool is only half the equation. One TikTok Shop seller described the loop the tool cannot run for you: "1 to 3 hero products, a strong TikTok-exclusive offer, competitive creator commissions, consistent sample outreach, clear hooks, not rigid scripts" (@jordantwestecom on X). If nobody has time to run that, a different login will not fix it.

Tokgency (the managed alternative)

If your issue is that Euka is one more system to operate, the fix is not another platform. Tokgency is a TikTok-only managed agency that runs the program and owns GMV, with flexible, commission-friendly pricing. Best for brands that want results without operating a tool. See Tokgency vs Euka.

The software alternatives

  • Reacher (~$199 to $599/mo): strong AI outreach and CRM. Best for outreach-heavy teams. Compare.
  • Cruva (~$199 to $599/mo): AI operating system with segmentation and community. Compare.
  • Colaba (~$59 to $249/mo): cheapest, bulk-outreach focused. Compare.
  • Hubfluence (~$149 to $399/mo): end-to-end at a lower seat price.

How to choose

  • Want stronger outreach: Reacher.
  • Want segmentation and community: Cruva.
  • Want it cheaper: Colaba or Hubfluence.
  • Do not want to run a tool: a managed agency.

The takeaway

Euka's best alternative depends on your reason for switching, features, price, or the operator problem. If the last one is your issue, no other tool solves it; a managed program does.

Want the outcome without the software? Book a call, or try the creator finder.
